info.title: Delhi Bus Atlas
info.description: Plan fixed-route bus journeys in Delhi. Times include a UTC offset. Durations are seconds. See the [API guide](/api-guide) for a runnable coordinate query and response interpretation.

get.description: Inspect timetable version, observational coverage and live-feed freshness.
Find boarding platforms by name or identifier, with optional station entrances.

parameters.name: include_entrances

schema.description: Include mapped metro street entrances alongside bus platforms.
schema.title: Include Entrances

parameters.description: Include mapped metro street entrances alongside bus platforms.

get.description: Plan from a stop ID, stop name or latitude,longitude. Optionally compare another hour on the same date.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Origin as latitude,longitude, stop ID or name, or a mapped entrance name or entrance_id.
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Origin as latitude,longitude, stop ID or name, or a mapped entrance name or entrance_id.

parameters.name: depart

schema.description: ISO 8601 departure. A timezone-free value uses Delhi time. Defaults to now.
schema.title: Depart

parameters.description: ISO 8601 departure. A timezone-free value uses Delhi time. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: preference

schema.description: Choose earliest arrival or weigh extra walking against the time saved. The public map uses balanced.
schema.title: Preference

parameters.description: Choose earliest arrival or weigh extra walking against the time saved. The public map uses balanced.

parameters.name: replay

schema.description: Use feeds received by the requested November capture clock.
schema.title: Replay

parameters.description: Use feeds received by the requested November capture clock.

get.description: Estimate the next service on a route for someone already at the selected platform.

parameters.name: route

schema.description: route_id from the journey bus leg.
schema.title: Route

parameters.description: route_id from the journey bus leg.

parameters.name: at

schema.description: Platform arrival time. Defaults to now.
schema.title: At

parameters.description: Platform arrival time. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: replay

schema.description: Replay the recorded November feed at the specified time.
schema.title: Replay

parameters.description: Replay the recorded November feed at the specified time.

get.description: Read a measured holdout or the matched-coordinate Google Maps and GPS comparisons.
Return the frozen trip forecasts and any dated, GPS-supported passenger simulations.

primary_count.title: Primary Count
primary_count.description: Number of immediately visible choices. Three are shown whenever the response contains at least three distinct feasible journeys. Up to two more follow.

faster_index.title: Faster Index
faster_index.description: Index in journeys of the faster option in the walking comparison.

less_walking_index.title: Less Walking Index
less_walking_index.description: Index in journeys of the shorter-walk option used for the time and walking comparison.

service_date.title: Service Date
service_date.description: GTFS operating date of this vehicle's stop forecast, in Delhi.

gps_age_seconds.title: Gps Age Seconds
gps_age_seconds.description: Seconds since the latest matching vehicle fix available at the request. Null when no fresh, dated physical run could be corroborated.

vehicle_approaching.title: Vehicle Approaching
vehicle_approaching.description: Two consecutive GPS observations moved toward the platform on its incoming published shape. The most recent observation was at most 60 seconds old at the request.

ready_at.title: Ready At
ready_at.description: Requested departure plus verified walking time to this platform.

fallback_itinerary.description: Feasible option boarding later at the same platform, if the conditional service has left.

observed_stop_id.title: Observed Stop Id
observed_stop_id.description: Upstream platform where this dated service was seen.

received_at.title: Received At
received_at.description: Local receipt time of the position evidence used.

route.title: Route
route.description: Route label shown to the rider.

boarding_position.description: Upstream position used to predict boarding time for this trip.

origin_departure.description: Dated GPS evidence at the first public stop. A downstream sighting alone cannot confirm the departure there. Absence of a matched report leaves the start unconfirmed.

live_run_id.title: Live Run Id
live_run_id.description: Opaque vehicle-run identifier when multiple corroborated vehicles share this scheduled trip.

model_sources.title: Model Sources
model_sources.description: Count of route intervals by timing source.

stop_count.title: Stop Count
stop_count.description: Served stops after boarding through alighting, inclusive.

same_platform_services.title: Same Platform Services
same_platform_services.description: Other direct lines serving the same boarding and alighting platforms. One eligible departure per line within 30 minutes of the passenger’s ready time.

departure.title: Departure
departure.description: Requested time to leave the origin.

arrival.title: Arrival
arrival.description: Estimated arrival at the destination after the final walk.

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Sum of walk, wait and ride seconds.

access_walk_seconds.title: Access Walk Seconds
access_walk_seconds.description: Origin to first boarding platform. Zero when already there.

walk_ready_at.title: Walk Ready At
walk_ready_at.description: Requested departure plus the mapped walking time to this stop.

seconds_before_walk_ready.title: Seconds Before Walk Ready
seconds_before_walk_ready.description: How much earlier the rider must arrive to meet this forecast.

departure.title: Departure
departure.description: Requested time to leave the origin.

arrival.title: Arrival
arrival.description: Estimated arrival at the destination after the final walk.

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Sum of walk, wait and ride seconds.

access_walk_seconds.title: Access Walk Seconds
access_walk_seconds.description: Origin to first boarding platform. Zero when already there.

issued_asof.title: Issued Asof
issued_asof.description: Cutoff for receiving observations used in this forecast or replay.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.description: Ranked alternatives. Empty if no usable path was found within the search limits.

nearby_alighting_option.description: A usable bus ride ending near the chosen destination when no complete mapped journey was found.

direct_from_nearby_platforms.title: Direct From Nearby Platforms
direct_from_nearby_platforms.description: Direct services from nearby platforms when the walk to board cannot be verified within the search limit. Times start at the boarding platform. These services are separate from the ranked door-to-door journeys.

boarding_alerts.title: Boarding Alerts
boarding_alerts.description: Direct services whose fresh live estimate just precedes the rider’s platform arrival. These are excluded from feasible itineraries.

earlier_boarding_options.title: Earlier Boarding Options
earlier_boarding_options.description: Upcoming direct departures before the mapped walk to board can finish. One upcoming departure per platform and line. Board only if you can reach that exact stop by its predicted departure; the planner does not time an alternative first mile.

journey.description: From the requested origin through the last bus stop only.

estimated_walk.description: Independently mapped street route when available; pedestrian access is uncertain.

departure_at.title: Departure At
departure_at.description: Departure at the named platform, conditional on the passenger already being there.

alight_at.title: Alight At
alight_at.description: Estimated time at the alighting platform.

straight_line_to_board_m.title: Straight Line To Board M
straight_line_to_board_m.description: Separation of the starting pin and platform. Walking distance and time to board are unknown.

egress_walk_seconds.title: Egress Walk Seconds
egress_walk_seconds.description: Mapped walk from the alighting platform to the destination.

approach_stop_id.title: Approach Stop Id
approach_stop_id.description: The preceding platform seen on both vehicles' approaches.

gap_seconds.title: Gap Seconds
gap_seconds.description: Time between the two vehicles' first GPS fixes inside the selected platform area on those passages.

window_seconds.title: Window Seconds
window_seconds.description: Length of the lookback at the time of the request.

origin.description: First public boarding stop on this scheduled run.

scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: Timetabled departure at the first public stop.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Latest receipt time allowed in this search.

id.title: Id
id.description: Official GTFS platform ID, or null for a map pin.

at.title: At
at.description: Time the passenger is assumed to be at this platform.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: Upstream GPS event used for this estimate, if any.

observed_service_gap.description: Interval between two distinct tracked buses at this platform via the same approach. GPS can miss buses. Passenger wait is estimated separately.

route_observation.description: Separately observed movement at the preceding stop. The vehicle has no matched timetable trip.

service_date.title: Service Date
service_date.description: GTFS operating date of this vehicle's stop forecast, in Delhi.

gps_age_seconds.title: Gps Age Seconds
gps_age_seconds.description: Seconds since the latest matching vehicle fix available at the request. Null when no fresh, dated physical run could be corroborated.

vehicle_approaching.title: Vehicle Approaching
vehicle_approaching.description: Two consecutive GPS observations moved toward the platform on its incoming published shape. The most recent observation was at most 60 seconds old at the request.

age_seconds.title: Age Seconds
age_seconds.description: Vehicle GPS age at the request.

endpoint_stops_considered.title: Endpoint Stops Considered
endpoint_stops_considered.description: Number of reachable platforms at the end with more choices. Both ends include every platform within the mapped walking limit.

direct_endpoints.title: Direct Endpoints
direct_endpoints.description: Direct-service searches consider connecting stops throughout the walking radius.

source.title: Source
source.description: Timing source at this call. A timetable or inferred call can follow a live anchor.

preceding_segment_seconds.title: Preceding Segment Seconds
preceding_segment_seconds.description: Previous served stop departure to this arrival. Null at boarding.

path_distance_m.title: Path Distance M
path_distance_m.description: Distance along the aligned GTFS shape. Null when unavailable.

estimated_speed_kmh.title: Estimated Speed Kmh
estimated_speed_kmh.description: Shape distance divided by predicted segment time. Null for an unreliable or missing distance or interval.

id.title: Id
id.description: Official GTFS platform ID, or null for a map pin.

via_stop.title: Via Stop
via_stop.description: A common next stop on routes boarding here. This helps distinguish platforms with the same name.

entrance_id.title: Entrance Id
entrance_id.description: Named pedestrian entrance identifier for use as a journey endpoint. Only returned when include_entrances=true.

street.title: Street
street.description: Street or landmark at a mapped pedestrian entrance.

transfer_buffer_seconds.title: Transfer Buffer Seconds
transfer_buffer_seconds.description: Minimum change allowance already included in this wait.

uses_steps.title: Uses Steps
uses_steps.description: The mapped walking path includes steps.

inferred_crossing_access_m.title: Inferred Crossing Access M
inferred_crossing_access_m.description: Metres of estimated street-level access to a mapped pedestrian crossing. These links have not been checked on foot.

uses_steps.title: Uses Steps
uses_steps.description: The mapped walking path includes steps.

inferred_crossing_access_m.title: Inferred Crossing Access M
inferred_crossing_access_m.description: Metres of estimated street-level access to a mapped pedestrian crossing. These links have not been checked on foot.
